name: @zerobias-org/context-pack-root
description: Shared toolchain packs for ZeroBias content packages
_comment: This root declares NO dependencies on purpose.
The packs exist to pin versions for their consumers. In a repo using the
zb.monorepo-* gradle plugins, Prepublish.resolve() rewrites each
package's dependency versions from the ROOT package.json at publish time
— which would silently replace the pins the packs are meant to carry.
Keeping the root dependency-free means there is nothing to hoist even if
that machinery is ever introduced here.
